title: The Day the Rooftops Played Hopscotch
description: On the first afternoon of school break, the chalk squares lift off the roof tiles. A child in a yellow cardigan takes the first turn across the lane.
alt: A child in a yellow cardigan hops across white chalk squares suspended between rooftops while friends wait on a terrace.
pairing: First day of school break × a hopscotch court suspended above a lane
